versions.changelog: Release 1.5.6: the conformance checker no longer reports invalid or unreachable targets as Level 0, and next-step guide and example links resolve outside a checkout. Audit-only upload of SKILL.md and MANIFEST.yaml under the MIT-0 consumer grant; no normative specification changes.

Correct audit-only upload inventory to SKILL.md and MANIFEST.yaml; ClawHub generates skill-card.md. Disclose the previously accepted MIT-0 consumer grant separately from canonical source licenses. Release 1.5.5 maintenance metadata; no normative specification changes.

- Added checker guidance identifying the smallest change needed to reach the next confirmed conformance level.
- Improved README onboarding, CI integration, RFC 9457 guidance, adopter registration, and adoption validation.
- Added concrete security examples for SC-2 through SC-6.
- Reconciled roadmap status, conformance counts, windowResetAt support, and repository standards documentation.
- Removed the roadmap-only agentCapable field from the published limits schema.
- Added deterministic ClawHub preparation for the audit-only SKILL.md and its provenance MANIFEST.yaml. ClawHub generates skill-card.md separately.
- Corrected ClawHub links and package metadata.
- No normative specification changes. Conformance levels, required fields, and response classes remain unchanged.

v1.5.3
- Updated the audit skill from internal revision 3 to 5, aligning it with Graceful Boundaries v1.4.0 checks for strict same-origin URL safety, optional quota and cost metadata, and untrusted Action Boundaries declarations.
- Replaced the overbroad 15-file package with an audit-only SKILL.md plus its provenance manifest; removed the builder, specification, docs, checker, and tests from the consumer artifact.
- Reconciled the canonical spec URL with the live /spec.md endpoint and current repository release identity.
- Repository v1.5.3 itself made no normative specification or checker behavior changes.

Agent-facing channels: builder skill (SKILL-builder.md), spec Appendix B for autonomous implementers, CLAUDE.md snippet. Landing page at gracefulboundaries.dev. Checker now validates Level 4 proactive headers. Error field requires snake_case. All URLs updated to gracefulboundaries.dev.
Remove Node.js runtime dependency. All assessment phases now use direct HTTP fetching. Node checker is an optional accelerator. Resolves OpenClaw security scan inconsistency.
Add Skill Provenance metadata to SKILL.md frontmatter. Add .clawhubignore for clean bundle packaging.
Initial release: conformance audit skill for the Graceful Boundaries specification. Includes the full spec, eval suite (104 tests), live conformance checker, and curl examples.
